events_catalog.scenario_text: An unpredicted mid-morning blizzard hits the GTA. The TTC Line 1 is entirely suspended between Bloor-Yonge and Union.

choice_a.action_text: Order an immediate surge-priced rideshare down to the Financial District.

choice_b.action_text: Wait outside on the platform for an overcrowded surface shuttle bus.

events_catalog.scenario_text: You run into a local supermarket for exactly three basic grocery items, but grocery math hits you hard at the checkout counter.

choice_a.action_text: Suck it up, pay the ridiculous $52 balance, and lose your meal prep liquidity.

choice_b.action_text: Leave the basket at the aisle, walk out empty-handed, and eat instant noodles instead.

events_catalog.scenario_text: You tap your Presto card at the turnstile and hear a loud double-beep. Your balance is deeply in the negative.

choice_a.action_text: Execute an immediate phone top-up of $30 via your clearing account.

choice_b.action_text: Evade the gate smoothly. Risk getting caught by fare inspectors to save the cash.

events_catalog.scenario_text: The inter-campus shuttle bus is completely full, and the outdoor lineup stretching past the sidewalk is moving at zero speed.

choice_a.action_text: Pay for a local GO Transit train ticket to bypass the student freeze.

choice_b.action_text: Stand in the freezing wind for another 45 minutes to preserve your liquidity.

events_catalog.scenario_text: You walk through the Eaton Centre to kill time between classes and find a massive pop-up clearance sale on local brand apparel.

choice_a.action_text: Splurge $85 on a sleek hoodie to fit in with the local campus culture.

choice_b.action_text: Keep your eyes locked on the floor, walk straight past, and drink free tap water.

events_catalog.scenario_text: It is 11:30 PM. Your major midterm exam is in exactly 9 hours and you have only reviewed 2 out of 11 heavy slide decks.

choice_a.action_text: Consume your inventory Surge Espresso, pull an all-nighter, and force-memorize the slides.

choice_b.action_text: Get 8 hours of premium sleep, wing the exam completely, and accept whatever grade drops.

events_catalog.scenario_text: The campus Tim Hortons line has 40 people in it, and your lecture starts in 10 minutes. Your brain desperately demands caffeine.

choice_a.action_text: Skip the lecture completely to secure your breakfast wrap and double-double.

choice_b.action_text: Sprint to the lecture hall empty-handed. Endure a 3-hour academic briefing with zero focus.

events_catalog.scenario_text: As you exit Yonge-Dundas station, an aggressive street marketer approaches you trying to block your path with a clipboard entry form.

choice_a.action_text: Make awkward eye contact, listen to their pitch for 15 minutes, and miss your connection.

choice_b.action_text: Deploy your Mississauga Commuter passive edge, pretend you are blind, and walk straight through.

events_catalog.scenario_text: The campus Eduroam Wi-Fi network completely collapses right in the middle of your timed online quiz submission window.

choice_a.action_text: Instantly switch on your phone's premium 5G data hotspot to save the submission score.

choice_b.action_text: Stare at the loading icon in pure panic. Let the session timeout and email your prof later.

events_catalog.scenario_text: Your economics professor locks 20% of your total class grade behind a digital homework portal access code that must be bought new.

choice_a.action_text: Pay the massive $125 portal access fee to secure your academic graduation tracking.

choice_b.action_text: Refuse to pay on principle. Try to clear the class using lecture slides alone.

events_catalog.scenario_text: Your student house landlord slips an unauthorized notice under your door demanding an immediate illegal rent increase for winter heating.

choice_a.action_text: Pay the extra $150 cash out of pocket to completely avoid an aggressive winter eviction battle.

choice_b.action_text: File an immediate legal dispute board claim. Suffer intense household psychological warfare.

events_catalog.scenario_text: Your evening Spadina streetcar gets completely gridlocked behind an illegally parked delivery van during a heavy freezing downpour.

choice_a.action_text: Abandon transit completely and walk 25 minutes through the heavy freezing rain.

choice_b.action_text: Sit in the gridlock for over an hour. Watch your evening study velocity hit zero.

events_catalog.scenario_text: Someone takes your wet clothes out of the student building dryer and throws them on top of the dirty counter to steal your cycle time.

choice_a.action_text: Pay for an entirely new washing cycle and wait around to guard the machine physically.

choice_b.action_text: Confront the room operator aggressively. Melt down your baseline sanity reserves in an argument.

events_catalog.scenario_text: Your student cafeteria card registers $0.00 and your fridge contains nothing but a single, ancient jar of store-brand condiment.

choice_a.action_text: Redeem your inventory Meal Plan Voucher item to access the elite dining hall buffet.

choice_b.action_text: Borrow $25 from a friend at a steep psychological cost. Buy a cheap fast food meal.

events_catalog.scenario_text: The Bloor-Yonge subway platform is at emergency capacity. People are pushing against the yellow line as trains pass empty.

choice_a.action_text: Squeeze violently into an overcrowded car. Sacrifice your safety baseline for speed.

choice_b.action_text: Exit the underground network completely. Walk 40 minutes uphill to save your health.
